lead: A star rating whose value is a single number. It supports half stars, read-only display and custom icons; the Left / Right arrow keys change the score and Home / End jump to either end.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.value: Value: `{value}` (click the current score again to clear it)

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The root, `role=slider`; `data-readonly` / `data-disabled`, and `data-hovering` while the pointer previews a score
styling.item: Each star; `data-fill` is full / half / empty
styling.icon: Two icon layers: the unselected one below, the filled one on top; for a half star the theme style clips the fill in half
styling.hit: The pointer hit area; two per star when half stars are allowed (`data-half` is the left half)
